stories.headline: OpenAI signs energy-sector deal with ADNOC and G42
stories.summary: ADNOC and G42 signed a deal to deploy OpenAI technology across the UAE energy firm's operations. The announcement shows enterprise adoption, but claims of operational benefits remain to be demonstrated.

stories.headline: China's robot makers race to improve AI brains
stories.summary: Chinese robotics firms are shifting investment from acrobatic hardware toward adaptable AI. Embodied-AI funding reached $13 billion in the first half, Reuters reports; demos do not establish reliable general-purpose operation.

stories.headline: Midterm closing day brings Michigan party split
stories.summary: Democrat Haley Stevens endorsed Republican Mike Rogers in Michigan's Senate race. A judge also rejected DOJ's bid to block Alaska certification if Dan Sullivan narrowly loses. Congressional control remains undecided.

stories.headline: US-Iran draft proposal circulates after Doha talks
stories.summary: Iranian negotiators left Doha as a draft deal circulated, an official told Reuters. A follow-up meeting is possible, but no agreement is announced; reopening Hormuz and ending the US blockade remain disputed.

stories.headline: Ukraine disputes Russia's use of humanitarian pause
stories.summary: Ukraine's military says Russia reinforced positions during the Oleshky ceasefire, which enabled nearly 800 evacuations. Ukraine's ombudsman said both sides met their obligations; the competing assessments are unresolved.
